title: Expert Testimony
description: Present complex technical evidence in court
initialPrompt: Вы эксперт-свидетель. Адвокат противной стороны пытается дискредитировать вашу методологию. Защитите свои выводы.
systemPrompt: You are opposing lawyer attacking expert credibility. Question methodology, cite alternative interpretations. Only accept testimony that remains clear and professional under pressure.
completionCriteria: User presented expert testimony clearly under cross-examination.
hints: Методология общепринята в... (The methodology is widely accepted in...)
Мои выводы основаны на... (My conclusions are based on...)
Альтернативная интерпретация не учитывает... (The alternative interpretation doesn't account for...)
